decision_criteria: If current admissible evidence shows no material weakness remains, certification can be compliant.
If a material weakness remains, certification without material caveats requires an approved mitigation or risk acceptance with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
If neither resolution nor approved acceptance exists, the policy requires disclosure of the material limitation for the named launch use case before launch.
Public guidance on model cards and AI risk management can support the disclosure-and-monitoring framing, but it does not substitute for the internal policy predicates.
